description: 5 opening rhetorical templates. Each skill JSON declares which it allows; the script LLM picks per video. Sentence-level rules (length cap, banned openers, did-you-know rule) live in style files instead — this file owns ONLY the rhetorical strategies.

universal_rules.specificity_required: Every hook must contain at least one of: named entity, specific number, or concrete action. No 'this character', 'a fight', 'something crazy'.
universal_rules.visual_pattern_interrupt: The hook should invite a visual punch — a name to slam on screen, a number to flash, a question mark.
universal_rules.breath_unit_allowed: A hook can be ONE flowing 15-25 word sentence as long as the contradiction is loaded inside it — fragmenting it across 3-4 short sentences usually weakens the impact. 'In 1901, a 63-year-old schoolteacher became the first person to survive going over Niagara Falls in a barrel.' is one breath that contains the entire premise; chopping it into 'A schoolteacher. Sixty-three years old. Survived Niagara Falls. In a barrel.' kills the cadence. Fragment only when the punch is the point (e.g. 'Toji killed Gojo.' is short on purpose because the brevity IS the shock).
universal_rules.contradiction_in_hook: The hook sentence itself must contain the contradiction, not set it up. Sentence 1 should already be the surprise. If sentence 1 is neutral fact and sentence 2 is the twist, the viewer scrolled before the twist. 'One man survived two atomic bombs' is a fact. 'One man survived two atomic bombs and died of a stomach ache' is a hook.

bold_claim.shape: Subject + counterintuitive consequence in one sentence. The claim must contain a causal twist or contradiction, not a superlative opinion. 'X did the impossible thing' beats 'X is the most [superlative] thing.'
examples: Toji killed the strongest sorcerer with zero cursed energy.
Furina spent 500 years scamming the heavens.
Saitama got everything every anime hero wants and it ruined his life.
bold_claim.fails_when: Superlative opinion with no contradiction ('X is the saddest/biggest/most underrated hero'), vague intensifier with no fact ('This is insane.'), or fact every fan already knows.

curiosity_gap.shape: Name the thing, withhold the reason. Viewer stays for the why.
examples: Ringo never lost a duel. The reason is colder than you think.
There's one technique Gojo refused to teach. Now you'll see why.
Furina has one ability nobody talks about. It's why she's banned in tournaments.
curiosity_gap.fails_when: Withheld answer is obvious, or tease is generic ('there's a hidden reason').

beat_map.shape: List-promise + tease one specific beat. Creates a completion contract.
examples: Three things about Ringo. Number two breaks JoJo's whole power system.
Five facts about Toji. The fifth one is illegal in Japan.
Four reasons Furina is the most cracked five-star. Reason three will end you.
beat_map.fails_when: The teased beat isn't actually the strongest, or the count is fake ('a few things' instead of a number).

in_medias_res.shape: Drop into a specific moment that already contains the contradiction. The snapshot itself must show the conflict, not set it up. 'Toji is bleeding out smiling' shows the twist in one frame; 'Ringo is on a hilltop with Johnny' is just an establishing shot. If the opening could be the wide-shot opening of a movie scene, push closer — to the frame where the conflict is already visible.
examples: Ringo is standing in a bar. Across from him: a man who just shot his wife.
Toji is bleeding out on a rooftop, smiling.
Furina is on stage. The entire nation is watching her cry.
in_medias_res.fails_when: The moment needs context to make sense, sounds narrated ('Picture this:', 'Imagine if'), or is a descriptive wide shot / neutral setup action (lighting a cigarette, walking into a room, standing across from someone) instead of a tension snapshot. If the contradiction is not already visible in the opening frame, the hook is too wide.

provocation.shape: Question or negation that flips received wisdom. Forces a reaction.
examples: Everyone says Ringo lost on purpose. They're wrong.
Why does every JJK fan get Sukuna's domain wrong?
Furina is not a healer. She never was.
provocation.fails_when: Strawman ('nobody talks about this' — except 50 other videos do), or rhetorical question with an obvious answer.
